cities.base: Central Helsinki, walkable to Market Square and Design District
cities.name: Helsinki

cities.base: Rovaniemi town center, close to Arctic Circle tour pickups
cities.name: Rovaniemi

cities.base: day trip from Helsinki, ferry from Market Square
cities.name: Suomenlinna

places.name: Aurora Hunting Drive (out of town)
places.note: Guided minivan trips run $80-180 per person; a rental car and a 20 minute drive away from town lights costs only gas. No guarantee of seeing anything, that is the nature of aurora hunting.

places.name: Ranua Wildlife Park
places.note: About an hour each way and 3 to 4 hours on site: polar bears, lynx and wolverines in large enclosures, not a roadside zoo. Open daily 10:00 to 16:00; 26.50 euros at the gate or 24.50 online, valid to 31 March 2027.

places.name: Arctic Circle Husky Safari
places.note: Door to door 3-4 hours including transfer from Rovaniemi hotels. Roughly $150-220 per person depending on sled length and operator, books out in winter so reserve ahead.

places.name: Rovaniemi Market Square (Kauppatori)
places.note: Small outdoor market, more limited and seasonal in deep winter than Helsinki's, good for a quick coffee and grilled snack rather than a full meal stop.

places.name: Restaurant Nili
places.note: Reindeer, whitefish and other Lapland dishes in a log-cabin room, mains 40 to 70 euros. Shut Sundays; Visit Rovaniemi gives 16:00 to 23:00 weekdays and from 14:00 Saturday, Wanderlog 17:00 to 22:00, so hours vary, check.

places.name: Lordinaukio (Lordi Square)
places.note: Small central square named for the Eurovision-winning band, mostly useful as an orientation point and a place to grab coffee between other things, not a destination on its own.

places.name: Arktikum Museum
places.note: Real museum on Arctic nature, Sami culture and regional history in a glass corridor building on the river, the best indoor option on a bitter day. 22 euros, 10:00 to 18:00; shut Mondays to 30 November, then open daily to 28 February.

places.name: Arctic Circle Line Marker (Napapiiri)
places.note: The actual painted line on the ground next to Santa Claus Village, free and quick, worth the two minutes it takes to straddle it and take the photo before moving on.

places.name: Arctic Circle Reindeer Park
places.note: Reindeer sled rides beside the village; the 400 m Reindeer Path is 40 euros. Open daily 10:00 to 16:00 to 29 November and to 17:00 from 30 November. Commercial, but the animals are real and you are already there.

places.name: Santa Claus Village Gift Shops
places.note: Rows of souvenir shops selling reindeer hides, wool goods, and Moomin merchandise. Marabou for browsing, not essential, prices run high.

places.name: Joulukka Christmas House
places.note: Smaller family-oriented Christmas experience with elf workshops, alternative to SantaPark if that's sold out or you want something quieter. Not essential if doing SantaPark already.

places.name: Husky Park at Santa Claus Village
places.note: On-site kennel to meet and photograph sled dogs without a full safari, 15 euros. Open 10:00 to 15:15 in November and 09:00 to 16:00 December to February; good filler if your safari is another day.

places.name: SnowMan World Ice Gallery
places.note: Ice sculpture gallery and ice bar, not running yet: it opens 6 December 2026, 10:00 to 20:00 to 6 January and 11:00 to 19:00 from 7 January to 17 March. 35 euros; it is cold enough that 45 minutes is plenty.

places.name: Santa's Salmon Place
places.note: Open-fire salmon soup and grilled salmon place inside the village, simple and warm, reasonable lunch stop rather than a destination meal.

places.name: Angry Birds Activity Park
places.note: Skip: an indoor play park tied to a mobile game, has nothing to do with Lapland and eats time better spent at the reindeer or husky areas.

places.name: Design District
places.note: Good jet-lagged first afternoon, not essential if you're tight on time.

places.name: Suomenlinna Fortress
places.note: Walk it for the harbour views. The visitor centre is open daily 10:00 to 16:00 and Suomenlinna Museum 10:30 to 17:00, worth it if it rains; the Ehrensvard Museum and Vesikko are closed now.

places.name: Suomenlinna Sea Fortress
places.note: Open all year, 15 minutes by ferry from Market Square; the ramparts walk and harbour views are the point. Visitor centre daily 10:00 to 16:00, Suomenlinna Museum 10:30 to 17:00; the Ehrensvard Museum and the Vesikko submarine are closed now.

places.name: Kauppatori (Market Square)
places.note: Harborside market for salmon soup, berries and reindeer skewers. Also the ferry departure point for Suomenlinna, easy to combine both in one stop.

places.name: Vanha Kauppahalli (Old Market Hall)
places.note: Indoor 1889 market hall right by the harbor, good for a sit-down lunch of smoked fish or reindeer without needing a reservation.

places.name: Helsinki Cathedral (exterior)
places.note: The white steps and facade are worth a look on the way through Senate Square. Skip going inside, the interior is plain and not worth queuing for.

places.name: Esplanadi Park
places.note: Short central park strip connecting Market Square to the shopping streets, easy to fold into a walk without planning around it.

places.name: Ateneum Art Museum
places.note: Finland's main collection of classic Finnish and European art, the rainy-day pick. 23 euros, shut Mondays; 10:00 to 18:00 Tuesday and Friday, to 20:00 Wednesday and Thursday, and to 17:00 at weekends.

places.name: Kiasma Museum of Contemporary Art
places.note: Rotating contemporary shows in a distinctive building near the train station, the fallback when the weather turns. 23 euros, shut Mondays; 10:00 to 20:00 Tuesday and Friday, to 18:00 Wednesday and Thursday, and to 17:00 at weekends.

places.name: SantaPark Arctic World
places.note: Underground theme park built into a rock cavern, elf school and rides aimed squarely at families with young kids. Pricey for what it is if you don't have small children along.

places.name: Santa Claus Main Post Office
places.note: Send a card stamped from the Arctic Circle; it sometimes arrives months later. Open 10:00 to 19:00 through November and 09:00 to 20:00 from 1 December to 6 January, cheap and a real keepsake.

places.name: Santa Claus Office
places.note: Meet Santa and get a photo; the photo package costs extra. Not open until 16 November, then 09:00 to 19:00 daily to 29 November and 08:00 to 20:00 from 30 November. Fine for kids, skippable for adults on a budget.

places.name: Arctic Circle Marker Line
places.note: The painted line and sign marking 66°33'N. Free, quick photo, everyone does it, that is fine, it takes fifteen minutes.

places.name: Santa Claus Village
places.note: Shops and photo ops straddling the Arctic Circle line, open every day of the year with hours varying by attraction. Free to walk; give it twenty to thirty minutes for the line photo, not a half day. The post office and the Santa photo are paid extras.

places.name: Korundi House of Culture
places.note: Former cold storage building turned contemporary art museum and concert hall, the indoor stop most itineraries skip. 13 euros, Tuesday to Sunday 11:00 to 18:00, shut Mondays.

places.name: Rovaniemi Airport 'Santa's Official Airport' terminal detail
places.note: Skip as a destination, it is just the airport with Santa branding and a gift shop, only relevant if you have a layover to kill.

places.name: Ounasvaara Hill
places.note: Wooded hill just across the river from downtown with walking trails and a viewpoint over the town and forest. In winter it doubles as a small ski and sledding area, easy to reach without a car.

places.name: Restaurant Elite
places.note: Classic brasserie on Time Out's 2026 Helsinki top 30, mains from 25 euros and starters from 15. Open daily from 12:00 on weekdays and 13:00 at weekends, to 22:00 Sunday to Tuesday and 23:00 Wednesday to Saturday.

places.name: Noodle Master Kamppi
places.note: Sichuan noodle bar on Time Out's 2026 cheap-eats list; order the dandan noodles at 14.90 euros. Open 11:00 to 21:00 on weekdays and 12:00 to 21:00 at weekends, a cheap lunch rated 4.7 from 820 Google reviews.

places.name: Restaurant Kuurna
places.note: Small dinner-only restaurant near Senate Square, two courses for 46 euros or three for 54 (Time Out, March 2026). Monday to Saturday 17:00 to 23:00, shut Sundays.

places.name: Baskeri & Basso (BasBas)
places.note: Wine-led bistro in a Punavuori courtyard: the set menu is 54 euros and a glass runs 12 to 15. Tuesday to Friday 16:00 to 01:00, closed Saturday to Monday; Wanderlog also lists a 12:00 lunch Wednesday to Friday, so check.

places.name: Arctic Restaurant
places.note: Dinner room on Valtakatu with mains 24 to 43 euros and starters at 16 (Time Out, December 2025), rated 4.7 from over 1,000 Google reviews. Open daily from 17:00; Wanderlog says to 22:00 and Time Out to 23:00, so hours vary, check.

places.name: Kauppayhtiö (Pure Burger and Pizza)
places.note: Burgers at 13 to 20 euros and pizzas at 14 to 21 (Time Out, December 2025). Shut Mondays; Tuesday to Friday 11:00 to 22:00, Saturday 13:00 to 22:00, Sunday 13:00 to 21:00.

places.name: Cafe & Bar 21
places.note: Cafe and bar with mains from 17 euros (Time Out, December 2025), rated 4.6 from over 2,400 Google reviews. Wanderlog gives Monday to Thursday 11:00 to 20:00, Friday and Saturday to 21:00, shut Sundays; Time Out lists longer hours, so check.

places.name: Jätkänkynttilä Bridge
places.note: Opened in 1989, with pillars shaped like a lumberjack's candle. Free and always open; give it 30 minutes for the views over the river, which is a bird migration route.

outings.why: A sea fortress reachable by a 15-minute ferry, the walk and harbor views are the point, skip the museums unless it rains.
outings.name: Suomenlinna sea fortress

outings.why: A dogsled run across the Arctic Circle, 3-4 hours door to door with hotel transfer, sells out in winter so book ahead.
outings.name: Arctic Circle husky safari

outings.why: A themed retail zone on the Arctic Circle line, worth twenty minutes and a photo, not more.
outings.name: Santa Claus Village

outings.why: Polar bears and lynx in large enclosures, an hour's drive each way and 3-4 hours on site to see it properly.
outings.name: Ranua Wildlife Park

outings.why: A snowmobile-to-lodge trip or a plain drive away from town lights, 3-4 hours after dark chasing a sky that never guarantees anything.
outings.name: Aurora hunting evening
outings.fallback: Stay in town and check the forecast again tomorrow, there's no consolation outing for a cloudy sky.

destination.name: Finland: Helsinki & Rovaniemi
destination.pitch: Helsinki for two easy nights bookending three days of Arctic Circle Lapland — huskies, wildlife, and a real shot at aurora, not a rushed one-day-does-everything tour.
destination.caveat: The aurora is never guaranteed and Lapland activities add up fast: a family of four can spend $600-800 just on the husky and wildlife park days. Put together for you just now from a live search, so check anything you're pinning the trip on.

because.city: Helsinki's Design District and Suomenlinna give two easy, walkable half-days without overreaching.
because.nature: Ranua Wildlife Park has polar bears and lynx in large enclosures, and the aurora hunt is the real thing if the sky cooperates.
because.culture: Suomenlinna sea fortress and Temppeliaukio Church cover the compact list of things worth seeing in Helsinki.
because.adventure: A husky safari across the Arctic Circle is the centerpiece day, book ahead in winter as these sell out.
because.exploration: Rovaniemi and the Arctic Circle are genuinely a different world from Helsinki, worth the domestic flight.
